name: Cloud Gouger
description: (Tag:electric)(Tag:fire)(Tag:ice)(Tag:weapon)One of the Seven Enchanted Blades, Cloud Gouger amplifies the user's energy into Clouds and Cloud Dragons for three techniques. Mei turns them into powerful lightning bolts or a speed-boosting lightning cloak; Yui turns them into massive ice bursts and freezing; Kou turns them into massive water waves or dense mist.
